head: SANS
dzh: 黑底荧光绿、粗斜体、大数字
den: Black with volt green, heavy italics, big numbers
nzh: 标题超粗斜体、全大写、字距收紧；荧光绿只给主按钮、进度和关键数字；配速心率这类数字做得很大，可用斜切色块；照片高对比有动感，橙色只做警示
nen: Heavy italic, all-caps, tightly tracked headings; volt green only on the main button, progress and key numbers; big pace and heart-rate numbers, slanted blocks are fine; high-contrast action photos, orange only for alerts
